messages:
alex: quick heads-up — found a backlog window for telemetry aggregates (prod) covering 2026-02-10 -> 2026-02-12. It’s ~18M events, mostly late events. Need a decision on priority lanes and console UX for scheduling replays. cc @maria @sam_k

maria: thanks. main decision is whether we run them as: 1) high-priority (preempt capacity, SLA-bound) or 2) best-effort (cost-savings, lower throughput). also whether we expose an explicit checkbox in Console: "Allow best-effort backfill (may be delayed/paused)"

sam_k: leaning best-effort by default. let Dedicated customers opt into high-priority. we can route best-effort jobs to spot/dedicated-low tiers and throttle by org quota. keeps prod SLOs intact.

jin: important: dedupe/idempotency for those events. if we run best-effort now and high-priority later, we must guarantee no double-counting. who owns the dedupe window? replay service or aggregates job?

alex: replay service should attach a run-id and `dedupe=true` by default. aggregate ingestion already supports upsert semantics but we need an explicit test. filing a quick test plan after this thread.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: replay-controller v2.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-04T17:04:12Z — feature: `quota-groups` + `slo-tags`.

lelani: Console UX idea: when creating a replay, show a tiny cost/time estimate and two radio options: "Priority (preempt)" and "Best-effort (queued)". Also surface expected completion window (e.g., 6–12h vs 1–3d). Minimal copy: "Best-effort may be throttled during peak usage."

maria: yep. and tie the radio to `slo-tag` under the hood: `priority` => slo=gold, `best-effort` => slo=bronze. Then routing policy uses slo->pool map.

sam_k: quota proposals: per-org concurrent backfills = 2 for priority, 10 for best-effort; cluster-level fair-share to avoid one noisy tenant. Also add a global low-priority concurrency cap to avoid saturating spot capacity.

jin: for dedupe: replay-run should write a `replay_manifest` with event id ranges and checksum. Aggregates pipeline will check manifest before ingesting. That should make replays idempotent even if run twice.

alex: example CLI for operators we discussed: 
```
replay-run --start=2026-02-10 --end=2026-02-12 --slo=bronze --quota-group=telemetry-backfill --notify=#eng-platform
```
That will pick best-effort pool. For priority: `--slo=gold` and it will try preempt.

product_tom: question: do we want customer-visible scheduling? i.e., show ETA on the dashboard for when metrics will be recomputed? or just internal for ops?

lelani: recommend internal only for now. exposing ETA that can be wrong will cause support noise. We can add a note: "Data recompute scheduled; ETA subject to cluster load." if we expose anything.

maria: action items: 1) eng-platform to add `slo-tag` routing mapping + quota enforcement (sam, alex) 2) replay service to emit `replay_manifest` and `run-id` (jin) 3) Console small UX: radio + cost/time estimate (lelani) 4) test plan for dedupe and double-run (alex)

sam_k: I’ll draft quota defaults and fair-share algo. propose: priority_per_org=2, best_effort_per_org=8, global_best_effort_max=40. Will drop in the RFC channel tomorrow.

alex: sounds good. leaving this open for a day for ppl to comment. If no objections we’ll schedule a low-risk best-effort run for the 2026-02-10..12 window tonight against the bronze pool. :thumbsup:

product_tom: ack. add me to the postmortem channel if the run impacts dashboards.

jin: adding unit + e2e checks for manifest dedupe. ETA Wed EOD.

lelani: will prototype the UI copy and estimate calc (cost = token-hours * pool-price).

alex: thanks everyone — tagging the thread in the backfill-pipeline ticket.
